recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下組織被片狀的中到大型非典型淋巴樣細胞取代，核泡狀、細胞質少到中量，其間夾雜不規則的粉紅色纖維素樣/壞死物質與小血管，反應性小淋巴球背景相對少；這種片狀大細胞合併壞死，符合高級別的淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫病，需以 EBER 與 CD20 確認。
features: Dense, sheet-like infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm
Scattered larger cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and occasional mitotic-appearing figures
Irregular geographic zones of pink fibrinoid/necrotic material and stroma interspersed within the infiltrate
Small vessels within the infiltrate; angiocentricity is not clearly resolved at this magnification
Relatively few small reactive lymphocytes compared with the atypical population; no well-formed granulomas
describe_en: Sections show a dense, sheet-like infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm, admixed with fewer small lymphocytes and histiocytes. Irregular areas of fibrinoid necrosis and stroma are interspersed, and small vessels are present, although transmural angioinvasion is not clearly demonstrated at this magnification. No well-formed granulomas are seen. In the stated context, the findings are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis with a large-cell-rich (high-grade) appearance, to be graded by the density of EBER-positive CD20-positive large B cells.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Forms monotonous sheets of large EBV+ B cells without the angiocentric, necrotizing extranodal (lung) presentation that defines LYG, though grade 3 LYG overlaps morphologically.
Is angiodestructive, necrotic and EBV positive but the tumor cells are CD56+ cytoplasmic CD3+ and CD20 negative.
Lacks atypical large lymphoid cells and instead shows neutrophilic microabscesses, palisading histiocytes and giant cells with ANCA positivity.
Shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/ALK markers and is EBER negative.
